listing.name: Xenogears (Weltall)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Upstream runtime package for Weltall; use own game files per documented setup, with upstream/player owning installation and runtime replacement. Observed release artifacts are evidence, not operational package selection or Portcove support. Limits: Upstream only: Upstream says both discs playable. BIN/CUE/CHD preserve movie audio; ISO/IMG lose it. Complete coverage remains an upstream claim. UE5 recreation; Japanese retail discs not playable, ISO/IMG lose movie sound vs BIN/CUE/CHD. Both discs upstream-playable claim, no Portcove qualification. Upstream platforms: Windows 10/11 x64 D3D12 and Linux 64-bit. USA/supported English undubs; Japanese retail discs unplayable. Original data: PS1 Xenogears USA or supported English undub own two discs. Exact source revision/hash and BIOS/firmware requirements not stated above remain Unknown in this review. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
